text: 1. **Step one: what the CRM does today.** I went through the public record: all 93 help-center articles, the 103 videos and the Shorts on AG's channel, 166 site pages and 65 snapshots of the pricing page since 2019, 54 posts and articles by the company, its founder, and its CTO. Full audit, every claim linked to its source: [crm-audit.html](https://patraianton.github.io/annuities-genius-crm-launch-kit/crm-audit.html). What it showed: AG has had a CRM since 2019. The Client Profile is a case file: reports, illustrations, documents, notes, and the E-App already land there. The conversation leaves it. In the GrantAI 2.0 demo the email opens in the agent's own mail app, and the call happens off-platform: "after I send it, what do I do next? I guess I'll call the guy and let him know there's something cool waiting in his mailbox." Texting exists for website leads, from one shared number; calls, a calendar, and inbox sync don't. So the launch isn't "we built a CRM" - it's "the conversation stays on the case", and texting is "now for every client, from your own number".
why: Every count in the sentence has a record: 93, 103, 166, 65, 54.

text:
## 4. Note for IMO admins and Case Design desks

Goes out a week before the agents' email, so desks hear it from us first; agents on an IMO's account get section 1 after their IMO has.

**To:** IMO admins and Case Design desks on Enterprise accounts
**Subject:** New for your Case Design desk: what the client said, sent with the case

Hi [First name],

You're hearing this a week before your agents do. From [date], agents on Annuities Genius can email, call, and book meetings from the client's case, with texting from the agent's own number as each one clears registration.

What it means for your desk:
- A Case Design request can now arrive with the client's emails, call notes, and questions attached - your desk designs for what the client actually asked, not only the numbers.
- Designed cases that stall after the illustration are production your agency never sees. Now the follow-up sits on the case [and Team Activity shows which designed cases got one].
- Nothing changes in the tools you give your agents today. [You decide whether calling and texting are switched on for your agency's account, and who pays for them.]

For your compliance team: texts go only to clients who've opted in, [from a number registered in the agent's own name]; a STOP reply ends texting on its own; [call recording follows the rule your agency sets]; [every message is kept on the case]. [Client conversations are never shared with carriers or other agencies.]

Your agents' launch email goes out on [date]. Want it to come from you? [We'll send it co-signed by [IMO name], or give you the copy to send under your own name.] Or book a 20-minute walkthrough for your desk: **[Book a time]**

Best,
Annuities Genius Team
why: The IMO note carries 7 TO-CONFIRM marks, at the limit, not over it.
